title: Observability: drain a Loki ring member (reversible)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove observability loki-3 --yes`. Stops nexus-loki on loki-3 (guarded by a >=2-ready floor); the Loki memberlist ring evicts it after the dead-member timeout and rebalances. Reversible via scale-out add.

observe.what: loki-3 drained from the ring; reason notes the ~60s self-heal + the scale-out add re-join path

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync stops the ring service with a >=2-ready guard; the memberlist ring self-heals — growing the ring is a terraform op, reported not skipped.
